messages:
devon: Quick ops note 1:00 UTC deploy for llm-router. We're going to open feature flag route_slice to 0.5% for a 10m soak, then 5% for 20m, then 25% if healthy. Includes lightweight kernel fix and fallback route improvements. @sam please own monitoring. @maria can you add changelog entry? :calendar:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: llm-router canary @ 21:00 UTC. Auto-slice policy: 0.5% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) if no gate fires. Healthcheck cadence: 20s.
maria: ack. I'll add note: "route_slice warmup, pinned model v3.1-qt, fallback tweak". Any pinning?
devon: pin model=v3.1-qt for canary only. we'll unpin after canary passes.
sam: Suggested safety gates: - error rate > 0.7% -> immediate rollback - p99 increase > +300ms for 5m -> hold and escalate - latency tail growth (p95) > +250ms -> slow ramp. Also prefer manual hold if DB throttling alerts fire.

ops-anne: Pre-warm caches on canary group for 8m. Set rollback drain to 45s. Also set deploy metadata to include change_window=night-ops.
devon: internal CLI to create slice:
```
redwood flag toggle route_slice --cohort 0.005 --phase soak --pin model=v3.1-qt --meta "deploy:6129990001;window:night-ops"
```
maria: release notes updated in PR #982: "route_slice warmup + v3.1-qt pin; rollback rules: err>0.7% / p99>+300ms / 5 failed healthchecks". Who's oncall?
sam: I'll be primed. ops-anne backup. I'll keep a low-latency dashboard open and set an alert rule for p99+300ms.
deploy-bot: Canary execute at 6129990025. Health pings now streaming to #eng-releases-canary (20s).
devon: First 5m telemetry: errorRate 0.08%, p95 +90ms, p99 +180ms. Good. Proceeding to scale to 5% in 5m unless objections.
maria: good to me. Posting short note in customer-facing release notes draft.
sam: watching graphs. If I see p99 spike > +300ms for 5m I'll flip flag off and drift traffic back to stable.

ops-anne: reminder: if rollback happens, set cohort-drain=45s and run cache warmup on stable nodes post-fail to avoid cold tail.
devon: copy. will leave runbook link in thread for postmortem if needed.
